title: Vishnu's Maya
translation: To the Goddess who, in all beings, is called Vishnumaya, the power of illusion: salutation to her, salutation to her, salutation to her, salutation again and again.
translation_hi: जो देवी सब प्राणियों में विष्णुमाया कही जाती हैं, उनको नमस्कार है, उनको नमस्कार है, उनको नमस्कार है, बार बार नमस्कार है।

words.note: Dative of sa: the correlative of ya.

grammar: Ya … tasyai: 'she who … to her'. The relative या and the correlative तस्यै frame every verse of this hymn.
Triple refrain: नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः: salutation to her, to her, to her, again and again. The repetition is the heart of the chant.
Visarga before t: नमः + तस्यै → नमस्तस्यै, like हारस्तारः.
